info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Estimates-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Estimates Retrieval API enables users to access detailed estimates related to various insurance claims. This endpoint allows insurance professionals and claim adjusters to retrieve accurate and comprehensive estimates, aiding in informed decision-making during the claims process. Typical consumers include insurance companies, adjusters, and internal audit teams who require quick access to claims data. This API streamlines the process of fetching estimates, enhancing operational efficiency and improving the overall customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve an estimate for a claim based on the provided parameters. It is designed to assist users in understanding potential costs and managing their expectations regarding claim settlements.

requestBody.description: Request body for estimating claims. This body should contain the necessary parameters for the estimation process.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsEstimatesReques.description: The request body for the GET operation related to claims estimate, expected to be in JSON format.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the estimate.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the estimate.

state.description: The current state of the estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Details of the audit associated with the estimate.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsEstimatesRespon.description: Response schema for the GET operation on claims estimate.

createdBy.description: The user who created the estimate.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the estimate was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the estimate was created automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details for the claims estimate.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can help in measuring the performance of the API endpoint.
